name: Apache NiFi Open Source Dataflow
free_limit: Apache-2.0 self-managed flow-based data routing, ingestion, event processing and transformation with provenance and a web UI; no software license fee or vendor usage quota.
watch_out: Runs on your own Java 21 host or cluster; compute, storage and external systems may cost money. Production requires trusted TLS certificates, authentication, authorization and careful exposure of the administration interface.
